0.name: School Quality Reports Data
0.note: Long format. 1 row for each school, metric, and year. The source holds more than 1,000,000 rows, so filter on the server with fetch_metric.

1.name: School Point Locations (APS 2024-08-28)
1.note: Gives each DBN a point. The ATS column is the DBN. Use it to put the proxy on the map. It covers public schools only, so it never matches a private or postgraduate school in the FacDB unit set.

2.name: NYC Building Footprints (BUILDING)
2.note: On disk, pulled 2026-04-12 by data/geo/download_nyc_buildings.py. 1,082,872 footprints and 99.1% carry a usable year; the source writes 0 for an unknown year and _proxies drops it. FacDB gives each unit a BIN, thus this is a key join and not a spatial one. WARNING: a year is NOT oriented. Every other proxy points 'higher is better', so a positive value means agreement. A positive value here says the model calls a NEWER unit better, which is a finding and not a test.
